nom: Lancôme Absolue Longevity MD Intercept Face Serum for Mid-Age

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly say it relieves dryness and can substitute for a moisturizer, though several others report it can feel drying, especially with twice-daily use, and one in her late 30s found it not hydrating enough for her needs.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report smooth, hydrated, taut-feeling skin, but more than one also reports more acne and increased oil production, suggesting it may suit them better in winter than in warmer months.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are sharply split: two report a reaction ranging from persistent redness and bumps (even on a hand patch test) to hives, while a much larger number, including some with rosacea or melasma, say it didn't irritate their sensitive skin at all.
segments.mature: Reviewers across their 30s to 50s, several using the product specifically for its mid-age, anti-aging positioning, report firmer, smoother skin and softer fine lines, though a handful say they haven't seen visible results yet after a few weeks.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report firmer, plumper skin and softer-looking fine lines or nasolabial folds, in some cases within a week; several others, including some who used it for three to four weeks, say they haven't seen a visible reduction in lines or pore appearance yet.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the serum as strongly hydrating, sometimes replacing their moisturizer; a meaningful minority instead report it can feel drying, particularly with twice-daily use, on first use, or on certain areas of their skin.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no irritation or redness; however, two describe a clear reaction, including one whose face became red, bumpy, and irritated even on a hand patch test, and another who broke out in hives, and one more reports mild stinging near the eyes.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who mentions her skin barrier says her skin sometimes feels tight and shiny, which she manages with a separate barrier-repair step.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who mentions discoloration reports it faded with about a month of daily use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts or clogged pores, including some prone to congestion; one reviewer with combination skin instead reports more acne while using it.
concerns.oiliness: Two reviewers with combination skin report noticeably increased oil production requiring extra powder during the day, suggesting the serum may suit them better as a cooler-weather product rather than for spring and summer.

aspects.libelle: High price relative to perceived results
A little goes a long way, bottle lasts
Visible anti-aging results take weeks to appear

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I tried this serum of and on for over a month before I realized it was causing a reaction. My usual routine is: Am- niacinamide and vitamin c serums, moisturizer, and sunscreen. Pm- retinol 3x week and moisturizer. Initially I tried this serum in the morning in place of my usual niacinamide serum. My fave felt sensitive after the first day and sensitive and bumpy after the second. At this point I took a break for a few days. Next, I tried it in the evening on non retinol days. Same result: sensitive, bumpy skin after a couple uses. I had to take a break and cut out all actives for a week before my skin felt normal. I tried using it once more but had to wash my face within minutes because it was red, bumpy and irritated. Usually, when I have a product that I cannot use on my fave I can at least use it on the body. However, this is unfortunately not one of those products. When I tried it in the back of my hand I had a similar reaction within 30 minutes.

extraits.titre: I wanted to love it but…..
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I recently tried the Lancôme Absolue ßx Intercept The Serum, and I really wanted to love it, but unfortunately, my skin didn't agree with it. After only a couple of uses, I broke out in hives, which I suspect may be due to vitamin C in its formula. While the serum is marketed for anti-aging benefits and promises a luxurious treatment with advanced ingredients like minospure and longevity actives, the reaction was too severe for me to continue using it. For the high price point, I personally don't think it's worth it, at least for sensitive skin like mine. I can see how it might be effective for others, but my experience wasn't positive. If you have reactive skin or a history of sensitivity to vitamin C, I would recommend patch testing first before splurging on this serum. Rating: 2/5 – Lovely packaging and concept, but not suitable for my skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Lancome makes some of the best products! I love this brand. This formula is silky soft and luxurious to apply to face and neck area and quickly absorbs into my combination type skin. There is a soft fragrance to the product, however, it quickly disappears after application - if you weren't looking for it, you may never even notice it's presence. It played nicely with all my makeup products. I never noticed any pillibg or disruption to my foundation applications. I removed one star because I did notice I had more acne when using this product and a lot more oil production throughout the day that required some powder application to keep my makeup looking fresh mid-afternoon. So, this may be a product best left for winter months when my skin needs the extra moisture and not spring/summer.

extraits.titre: Promising in improvement skin texture and firmness
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have tried Lancôme Longevity MD Intercept Serum. First of all, the package is very luxurious and elegant. I really like it. I have been using this serum for several weeks. As someone at 40s with combination skin, I found this serum is creamy, silky, and non-greasy formula excellent for layering under makeup. While I haven't seen any visible results yet, my skin feels hydrated and taut. However, I experienced increased oil production. I think this will be more beneficial for winter user or someone with dry skin. Additionally I don't see visible reduction on pore appearance. Despite these issues, the improvements in skin texture and firmness are promising.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] For having dry and sensitive skin, I need to not switch serums daily. I have to give it time to test out a new one. Being familiar with Lancome products. I used it once daily at first then after a few days used it twice a day. It worked wonders for me. As my skin adopted to the serum it gave it a glow and reduces fine lines. Sometimes the skin feels tight and shiny but nothing a barrier fix can't repair. Packaging is gorgeous and only one pump is needed. Gifted by Lancome.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] As a woman in my 50s, my skin has definitely changed dryness, visible pores, and loss of firmness started bothering me lately. I've been using Lancome Longevity MD Intercept Serum for a while now, and honestly my skin feels healthier and smoother. The texture is silky and lightweight, absorbs beautifully, and leaves no sticky or greasy residue. It wears so nicely under makeup and gives my skin a soft, hydrated glow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this product daily for over a month. It feels smooth and calming going on. I like that it didn't impact my sensitive skin negatively. I notice my skin is smoother and discoloration has faded. Both pictures are with no makeup.
